author: potatoarmor
body:
Application
Age:  16
Timezone: CT (Central Time Zone/ GMT -6)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No:  Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
 No, I've grown to avicus three or more years ago and never had the opportunity to apply

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
I feel my biggest weakness is the fact I sometimes have biases, whether it be towards players I like or players I do not like. My stregnth? My biggest strength would be the available time I have to hop onto avicus and play/ hopefully moderate on.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
 I can be an extra set of eyes for the times of need.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
A successful leader must be confident, strict, quick on their feet (figure of speech), and be able to follow the rules. I personally dont think I possess some of these major traits. I dont believe I am as strict as I think a successful leader ought to be. I know I can follow all rules and can be confident when confronting reports or global messages during games when needed. I follow rules and do what is right.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
an attribute I would like to point out is my awareness for different clients or mods; im sure most mods can now see who hacks and who doesnt, but some clients That hackers use and mods dont see, only a few people are aware, i know of some ( Dont use these ) and hopefully can master these certain assets as I continue my moderating.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? 
I believe you should have the ability to know when to fool around/ play, and when to act serious and assert enforcement upon those needed. I feel as if I have the ability to do this, I am very familiar with the community and I am sure they would understand and respect me when I become serious


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
 I dont think my hours will fluctuate from now, of course unless I get a job which im not planning on as far as right now.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
Freeze and ping on staff slack for moderators to come, because kicking isnt helping anything if they keep coming back.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? I would bicker at the moderator and force them to leave. If they refuse I feel as if a punishment with approval of higher staff would be necessary.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? I think you would have to let them go for not having proof. You must be able to keep evidence safe so this situation doesn't happen.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? Pull a Fouled because he knows what is right, and punish the staff member accordingly.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? If I didnt know there were more components of the issue I would probably be upset from what I have heard and would talk about it amongst other staff members, but if they would tell me otherwise I would regret my thoughts and would reconsider my actions and learn for next time to not judge a book by its cover, or read upon it myself before judging.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
An accomplishment. The allotted time I have played on here makes me want to give back and being the role model I once looked up to.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
Avicus is the #1 server I play on and I have stayed loyal to this day after 3+ years. Avicus means to me that all my minecraft experiences have come from here. It means the world to me from the skywars days of mc.co, to the walls games of avic.us. I wouldnt be where I am today if it weren't for Avicus and its community.

Do you speak any other languages than English?
 I am learning Spanish at the moment, I am taking the third year of Spanish right now (95%), and am planning to take Spanish 4.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
I did this all on my phone and there might be many grammatical errors which I do sincerely apologize, half the text gets cut out  so I cant read it. I hope you guys will give armoredpotato a chance to moderate the people of Avicus.
